description: Sentinel-based verification proving actual byte consumption. Sentinel files have known content and SHA256; verify_artifact_reads reads them and returns evidence matching the sentinel values.

ALPHA.purpose: valid normalized artifact — positive read verification

BETA.used_as: replacement after selection, detected by hash mismatch

GAMMA.used_as: replacement with same length as ALPHA, different content

key_invariant: Sentinel content is NOT generated by the function under test. It is independently created, hashed, and stored. The test verifies that verify_artifact_reads reads the ACTUAL bytes and computes the CORRECT hash — not a cached or fabricated one.
